answer.text: No, the manual gives different front fork oil quantities for the left and right forks.
The right (RH) fork takes 589 ± 2.5 ml of front fork oil.
The left (LH) fork takes 507 ± 2.5 ml of front fork oil.

disclaimers.text: The manual says these values are approximate and the actual capacity will vary.

watchout_review.reason: The caution is about using the wrong oil grade, not about fork oil quantity.
